title: Visible Is Not the Same as Needed

scenes.visual: Title card: Visible Is Not the Same as Needed.

scenes.tts: L I P firing looks like the running total. But does the decision actually need L I P?
scenes.caption: LIP firing looks like the running total. But does the decision actually need LIP?
scenes.visual: The converging LIP ramps from chapter two. The question appears as on-screen text.
scenes.narration: LIP firing looks like the running total. But does the decision actually need LIP?

scenes.tts: A recording shows what activity goes with a choice. Only changing the activity can test whether the choice depends on it.
scenes.visual: Split card: left, a recording electrode, labelled goes with; right, a hand turning a dial, labelled depends on.
scenes.narration: A recording shows what activity goes with a choice. Only changing the activity can test whether the choice depends on it.

scenes.tts: M T passed a first test. Researchers passed weak current into small clusters of M T neurons that shared a preferred direction.
scenes.caption: MT passed a first test. Researchers passed weak current into small clusters of MT neurons that shared a preferred direction.
scenes.visual: An electrode tip in a cluster of MT neurons, all with rightward arrows. Small pulses flash.
scenes.narration: MT passed a first test. Researchers passed weak current into small clusters of MT neurons that shared a preferred direction.

scenes.tts: The monkeys chose that direction more often, as if that motion had been added to the dots.
scenes.visual: A psychometric curve slides sideways toward more rightward choices on stimulated trials.
scenes.narration: The monkeys chose that direction more often, as if that motion had been added to the dots.

scenes.tts: Katz, Yates, Pillow and Huk then silenced each area in turn, in rhesus monkeys.
scenes.visual: Names on screen: Katz, Yates, Pillow & Huk, 2016. A monkey brain with MT and LIP both outlined.
scenes.narration: Katz, Yates, Pillow and Huk then silenced each area in turn, in rhesus monkeys.

scenes.tts: They used muscimol, a drug that activates gabba A receptors and quiets nearby neurons.
scenes.caption: They used muscimol, a drug that activates GABA-A receptors and quiets nearby neurons.
scenes.visual: A syringe tip releases a small cloud; the neurons around it fall silent. Label: muscimol, GABA-A receptor agonist.
scenes.narration: They used muscimol, a drug that activates GABA-A receptors and quiets nearby neurons.

scenes.tts: Predict each outcome. If L I P is the accumulator, what happens when you silence M T? And when you silence L I P?
scenes.caption: Predict each outcome. If LIP is the accumulator, what happens when you silence MT? And when you silence LIP?
scenes.visual: On-screen card with two blanks: silence MT, ?; silence LIP, ?
scenes.narration: Predict each outcome. If LIP is the accumulator, what happens when you silence MT? And when you silence LIP?

scenes.visual: The question stays on screen; a small countdown ring runs.

scenes.tts: Silencing M T impaired motion discrimination.
scenes.caption: Silencing MT impaired motion discrimination.
scenes.visual: Split screen, left: after muscimol in MT, the psychometric curve flattens.

scenes.tts: Silencing L I P produced no measurable impairment of the motion decisions, in the tasks tested.
scenes.caption: Silencing LIP produced no measurable impairment of the motion decisions, in the tasks tested.
scenes.visual: Split screen, right: after muscimol in LIP, the curve largely overlaps the control curve. Label: no measurable change in these tasks.
scenes.narration: Silencing LIP produced no measurable impairment of the motion decisions, in the tasks tested.

scenes.tts: Did the injection simply miss? The same monkeys did a free-choice task, with no right answer.
scenes.visual: A question mark over the injection site. Then two targets with no dots between them. Label: free choice.
scenes.narration: Did the injection simply miss? The same monkeys did a free-choice task, with no right answer.

scenes.tts: After L I P inactivation, they chose targets in the affected part of space less often.
scenes.caption: After LIP inactivation, they chose targets in the affected part of space less often.
scenes.visual: A bar chart of choices tilts away from the silenced side of space.
scenes.narration: After LIP inactivation, they chose targets in the affected part of space less often.

scenes.tts: And their eye movements to that side landed less accurately. So the drug had acted on L I P.
scenes.caption: And their eye movements to that side landed less accurately. So the drug had acted on LIP.
scenes.visual: The target, with schematic target-relative landing points before and after LIP inactivation; after inactivation the points sit farther from the target. Label: increased endpoint error; the drug acted.
scenes.narration: And their eye movements to that side landed less accurately. So the drug had acted on LIP.

scenes.tts: That control is what makes the null result readable. Still, a null result cannot rule out other areas compensating.
scenes.visual: A small card: control shows the drug acted; compensation not excluded.
scenes.narration: That control is what makes the null result readable. Still, a null result cannot rule out other areas compensating.

scenes.tts: Other studies did find deficits after parietal inactivation. So the result is debated.
scenes.visual: A short list appears: Zhou & Freedman 2019, deficits after parietal inactivation; Jeurissen and colleagues 2022, biases that faded.
scenes.narration: Other studies did find deficits after parietal inactivation. So the result is debated.

scenes.tts: In one study, the biases faded while the area was still silenced. That suggests other areas compensated.
scenes.visual: A bias that shrinks while a silenced-area marker stays lit.
scenes.narration: In one study, the biases faded while the area was still silenced. That suggests other areas compensated.

scenes.tts: Which areas a decision needs remains an open question.
scenes.visual: A brain map with LIP, frontal eye field and superior colliculus marked with question marks.
scenes.narration: Which areas a decision needs remains an open question.

scenes.tts: If a decision adds up evidence, the adding happens somewhere, perhaps in several places. But a neuron that shows the running total is not always the place it is needed.
scenes.narration: If a decision adds up evidence, the adding happens somewhere, perhaps in several places. But a neuron that shows the running total is not always the place it is needed.
